tube.reference_insertion_status: 29 reference collet top minus −25 inside tip; provisional until actual fitting shoulder/thread length and tube pass-through are measured.
tube.workflow: Keep the outlet mounted permanently. Hold the detached PTFE lead free end away from the mounted outlet for hand access. Thread filament into that detached lead and feed it until it emerges at the printer end. Then slide the PTFE lead along the filament into the outside fitting and through the body to its provisional insertion mark. Reconnect the printer after filament emerges. Remove the entire PTFE lead for storage; the outlet stays mounted.
